value: Set the frame count used by every Nudge and Inbetween command.
left: Move the targeted keys left by the Nudge Value.
left_all: Move every key on the targeted animation curves left.
left_scene: Move every animation key in the scene left.
right: Move the targeted keys right by the Nudge Value.
right_all: Move every key on the targeted animation curves right.
right_scene: Move every animation key in the scene right.
insert: Insert time after the current frame by the Nudge Value.
insert_scene: Insert time after the current frame on every animation curve in the scene.
remove: Remove time after the current frame by the Nudge Value.
remove_scene: Remove time after the current frame from every animation curve in the scene.
